17. He also submits that it is not comet to say that the identity of the survey related with the khatian and plot numbers of the suit land have not been given in the plaint. He referring the plaint submits that the khatian and plot numbers are related with the settlement khatian. In this connection he also submits that when the first record of right was started under the provision of Bengal Tenancy Act in some of the area of our country. The first record of right is known as C.S record of right, that is, Cadstale Survey and in some district the same survey is known as settlement khatian. In the area of Mymensingh the first survey is know as settlement khatian and the same has been given in the pleadings. He candidly admits that it is fact that in the schedule of the plaint there is no identity of the survey and the same should have been there and if it would have been their, their would have no scope to create any confusion and unwanted debit on this fact. 

 18. He also submits that in the record of right there appears no name of the concerned survey. After C.S. record of right in many area of our country revisional survey, that is, R.S. record of right and after coming operation of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act the S.A record of right has been prepared but in no record of right, the name of the survey has been articulated by the authority. So, it is not a ground for disbelieving the case of the plaintiff.
